rationale: All runs are feasible with wide hold and slew/cap headroom, so only T_eff matters. Tight targets (frac 0.48-0.52) gave 6.96-7.64 ns. Best is md5's config (AREA 3, ABC buffering+sizing, timing-driven placement, post-GRT timing repair, cap213): 6.955 ns with +0.8 ns slack at a 7.75 ns target, already below the tightest allowed target (0.45 = 7.02 ns). The two best runs (md5, des 7.30) share cap213 and post-GRT timing repair; AREA 3 is consistently strong. So pin period_frac=0.45 to test this config at its claimed clock (trustworthy T_eff for re-runs, harder repair push) and pin md5's synthesis/RC/placement/timing-repair choices; leave utilisation, density, margins and remaining repair knobs to TPE.
